result.answer:
What you actually agreed to: only a conditional final review — you offered to review after the data checks and layout exist, and you explicitly did not guarantee the 18:30 deadline ('I can offer a final review after the checks; I cannot guarantee 18:30'). He also stated on the record that your review stays a conditional offer and that sending with the summary marked pending, plus telling the client and manager, is his own decision. Nothing further from you was accepted; you even flagged your final question as 'a question, not my acceptance of the job.'

What remained proposals or unconfirmed: Rui's source check (offered, not committed, estimated until ~18:20 with uncertain result), Ning's layout work (he asked for the word to start), He's fallback plan (send proposal at 18:30 with the summary marked pending), and the exact wording of the 'pending' note, which Rui flagged as still needing care. What has not been done: no data were actually checked during the conversation, no layout was started, and the deadline itself remained fixed by the client's email — only the scope of what gets sent is conditional.
